proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5239 jīva gives regional jiu/jiw life and explicit mind/heart senses in its addenda. Dang jiw heart is compared with that vital-spirit noun, preserving the elicited heart sense rather than claiming it is always anatomical. Exact survey form dʒiw is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6459 *duvāra gives Nepali duwār and regional duār door. Dang dawar fits that expanded door stem with the unstressed vowel retained. Exact survey form dʌwaɾ is preserved.

records.Source: webster[Appendix B, printed p. 31 (PDF p. 36), item 28, DDK]

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5523 *ḍag section 1 explicitly gives Oriya ḍagara road and regional ḍagar. Dang ḍagara path matches the retroflex branch, not dental dag in section 3. Exact survey form ɖʌɡʌɾa is preserved.
